business_problem: As Notino expanded across 27 European countries, fragmented spreadsheet-driven planning made it hard to align finance and operations, validate data quickly and respond to changes across the business.
solution_summary: Notino implemented IBM Planning Analytics through ADEOS's APOLLO solution to create a unified planning environment for finance, sales, marketing, logistics and operations. APOLLO provided prepackaged data models, planning forms, reports and analytical views, so the team did not have to build the environment from scratch. IBM Planning Analytics became the execution and calculation core, consolidating data from across markets and functions into a single source of truth used by more than 80 active users. Budget templates that once required manual setup across many spreadsheets are now parameter driven, while consolidation and validation of 130-plus Excel inputs run automatically instead of being restarted after every change. The design connects strategic, financial and operational planning in one environment, replacing fragmented handoffs with a governed collaborative workflow that supports faster forecasting and profitability decisions across the entire European business.

solution_components.name: IBM Planning Analytics
solution_components.role: Provides the planning, calculation and forecasting engine that unifies financial and operational planning across Notino's markets.

solution_components.name: APOLLO
solution_components.role: Supplies prebuilt data models, planning forms and analytical views that accelerate the rollout of Planning Analytics.

data_flow: Financial and operational inputs from functions across 27 markets flow into APOLLO and IBM Planning Analytics, where they are consolidated, validated and forecasted before reporting systems and planning users consume the updated numbers.
business_outcome: Notino shortened planning cycles from months to weeks, turned manual consolidation into an automated process and gave business teams a shared planning platform that supports quicker, more confident decisions across its European footprint.
